notes.title: Bug Fix - Changelog V0.1.3
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing the game over the past week. Today we bring the first update for Cyber Puncake!

Bug Fixes


 Fixed steamVR loading issue
 Fixed openXR backend support for Virtual Desktop streaming

notes.title: Cyber Puncake is AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Welcome to New Dragon City! We are excited to announce that Cyber Puncake has officially released on Steam!

20% Launch Discount！

To our incredible fans, a heartfelt thank you for your unwavering support throughout Cyber Puncake's journey. As a token of our appreciation, enjoy a special 20% launch discount when you purchase Cyber Puncake within the first week of launch!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361840/_/

Cyber Puncake’s Enchanting Soundtrack Bundle! 

Experience the citypop radio of New Dragon City with our original soundtrack (OST)! For a limited period, secure both the game and the OST at a special bundle deal of just $8 USD!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39114/_/

About the Game

In Cyber Puncake, you will play as a pancake chef, on a never-ending snack cart, constantly making “chinese crepes” for the customers who come by, and getting ratings and ingredients.

First sprinkle some flour, beat some eggs, add some scallions, and finally add some toppings, spread some sauce, and a piece of authentic 'Jianbing guozi' is freshly baked!
